annotations.title: Get the status and charge of a past paid call by its proof id

description: Gets the outcome of one past paid call (job, chat, listing run, shelf buy or recommendation) by its proof id: status, amount charged, the ledger legs on your account, usage, and the signed public proof with its check. Jobs here run synchronously; every paid answer carries its proof id (result _meta.proof). Use it to confirm what a call did and cost, or to fetch its proof for a dispute. Use account_balance instead for your overall balance. Use seller_statement instead for all rows in a period. Free: reading a receipt is never charged. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 400 bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 404 unknown_receipt (no call of yours has this proof id).

proof.description: The call's proof id: _meta.proof of an MCP result, or the X-Proof header of an HTTP answer.

name: job_status
